incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark smoke plume rises from the horizon, dominating the sky above a line of trees and a few houses. The scene suggests a large fire or explosion.

observations.description: Large, dense, dark gray smoke plume rising from the horizon and filling the sky.
A few houses are visible in the foreground on the right side of the image.
A dense line of dark trees forms a horizon line across the image.
The sky is filled with dark, heavy clouds, suggesting an impending or ongoing disaster.
